sentence_stem: Although the puppy has got a small bed,
correct_completion: it always sleeps on the sofa.
full_sentence: Although the puppy has got a small bed, it always sleeps on the sofa.
acceptable_variants: it does not use the bed.

options.text: so it sleeps on the sofa.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. After 'although', the clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence.

options.text: it always sleeps on the sofa.
it has got a very big bed too.
options.why_wrong: This adds the same idea (another bed) and does not contrast with the small bed mentioned in the first part.

options.text: it has got a bed for two.
options.why_wrong: This gives more information about the bed but does not provide the contrasting action expected after 'although'.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and 'have got' for possession
explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Ukrainian speakers sometimes use a linker that expresses a result where English needs a contrast, so check the meaning of the linker before choosing the completion.
translation: Хоча в цуценяти є маленьке ліжко, воно завжди спить на дивані.
